purpose_context: Doctrine, org, fetched, and charter packs describe what they contain in two incompatible manifests today (counts vs enumerated), and the built-in reference pack every other pack extends has none — so pack contents and parent/lineage cannot be verified or navigated consistently. This mission unifies pack metadata onto a single canonical manifest per ADR 2026-08-16-1, making packs trustworthy, navigable units and providing the substrate for verified distribution (epic #2539).
purpose_tldr: Give every pack one verifiable manifest of its constituent parts and lineage, replacing two divergent formats.
